reviews.body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are reported for the change handling missing optional comments in MISP imports. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes #8562 by allowing the MISP file import connector to process attributes and object references that omit the optional `comment` field. **Changes:** - Defaults missing attribute comments to an empty string so indicators and observables can be created. - Safely handles missing object-reference comments when building relationship descriptions. - Adds a regression test asserting that an attribute without a comment produces both an indicator and an observable. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `internal-import-file/​import-file-misp/​tests/​test_main.py` | Adds regression coverage for an attribute without a comment. | | `internal-import-file/​import-file-misp/​src/​import-file-misp.py` | Handles optional comments in attribute processing and relationship descriptions. |
Review effort: Balanced
